title: C++ Game Development
description: A structured C++20 path from first principles to game engine engineering.

modules.title: Toolchain, compilation and first program
modules.description: Understand how C++ source becomes a running program.

modules.title: Program structure, headers and namespaces
modules.description: Organise code into translation units and maintainable interfaces.

modules.title: Types, variables and constants
modules.description: Model game data safely with C++ types and initialization.

modules.title: Console input and output
modules.description: Read, parse and validate player input and game configuration.

modules.title: Operators and expressions
modules.description: Understand arithmetic, comparisons, conversions and expressions.

modules.title: Decisions and loops
modules.description: Build game rules, menus, state transitions and iteration.

modules.title: Functions and interfaces
modules.description: Design small, testable functions with clear contracts.

modules.title: Arrays, strings and views
modules.description: Represent text and sequences while understanding bounds and views.

modules.title: Structs, enums and value types
modules.description: Create domain types for players, enemies, items and states.

modules.title: Classes and encapsulation
modules.description: Protect invariants and design cohesive game objects.

modules.title: Constructors, destructors and lifetime
modules.description: Understand object construction, destruction and RAII.

modules.title: Pointers, references and const
modules.description: Use indirection safely and understand aliasing and lifetime.

modules.title: Ownership, dynamic memory and smart pointers
modules.description: Express ownership with RAII, unique_ptr and shared_ptr.

modules.title: Copy, move and value semantics
modules.description: Control resource transfer and avoid unnecessary copies.

modules.title: Containers, algorithms and iterators
modules.description: Use the standard library and reason about complexity and locality.

modules.title: Templates, concepts and compile time
modules.description: Build reusable generic components with compile-time constraints.

modules.title: Errors, debugging and testing
modules.description: Investigate defects with diagnostics, tests and sanitizers.

modules.title: CMake, multiple files and Git
modules.description: Build reproducible multi-file projects and collaborate with Git.

modules.title: Console game architecture and game loop
modules.description: Integrate game state, entities, update order and timing.

modules.title: Engineering quality, profiling and next steps
modules.description: Apply testing, profiling and architecture principles to future engine work.
